title: Landing record (F154-FR-050 to F154-FR-054; data-model.md D11)
description: One landing of a stage of a wide group: the rebase, the full gate on the rebased tree, the fast-forward, the approvals rewritten (F154-FR-050). PROPOSAL of spec 154. The stage lands home in declared order by a rebase onto home and a fast-forward, by nothing else; the full verification gate of the stage's last phase runs on the rebased tree before home fast-forwards (F154-FR-051). A rebase conflict or a red gate parks that stage alone, with exit 22 for that stage, home unchanged and no model called (F154-FR-052). Decided by `landing-table.json` (LD-1…LD-4); a record without a fast-forward resumes the landing at LD-1's rebase. The approvals stand bound to their verdicts and the rewrite of each approval commit is noted (F154-FR-053); no critic is called again (F154-FR-054; CQ-154-06 A). The record binds the rebased tree's fingerprint and the gate result. A ledger kind `parallel` (row 184, proposed).

branch.description: The stage's branch, rebased onto home by the runtime's hardened git (F154-FR-071).

home.description: The home branch the stage lands on.

rebasedOnto.description: The commit of home the branch was rebased onto.

started.description: False when the record was written before the rebase began (a resume state).

conflict.description: True on LD-2: the rebase was aborted and home is unchanged.

gate.description: The full verification gate of the stage's last phase, run on the rebased tree through the check runner under the P4 slot.

record.description: The logical name of the gate result record, or null when it did not run.

passed.description: True on LD-1; false on LD-3 (red gate, park).

treeFingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the rebased tree the gate ran on.

fastForward.description: True once home fast-forwarded (LD-1). False while the landing is parked or half landed.

approvals.description: The stage's approval records; each stands bound to its verdict, with the rewrite of its commit noted.

exitForStage.description: 22 when the stage is parked (the existing exit 22); null otherwise. No exit code is added (F154-FR-002).
